title: squarespace.get_contact
description: Input/output contract for retrieving a single contact record. Contacts live on their own base URL and API version: https://api.squarespace.com/v1/contacts (v1), NOT the 1.0 commerce base — CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11. That base already ends in /contacts, so the action requests path /contacts/{id} — src/client.ts's resolveUrl() resolves this by treating the base as the collection root and appending only the id, rather than doubling the segment into /contacts/contacts/{id}. CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11: resolveUrl() produced exactly https://api.squarespace.com/v1/contacts/{id}, a request to that URL reached the real API, and — on a second live call, 2026-08-11, against a real contact id — returned a 200 with an actual Contact record. VERIFICATION STATUS: both URL resolution/auth AND the response shape are now CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, though the shape is based on exactly one real record, so field optionality beyond what was observed is still inferred, not proven. The real response is WRAPPED in a top-level `contact` key — `{ contact: {...} }` — not flat, which is a correction from the earlier (wrong) placeholder-fixture model. The earlier model's `email`, `transactionalEmailStatus`, `lastModifiedOn`, `phoneNumbers`, `notes`, `lists`, `tags`, and flat `address` fields do NOT appear on this record; instead the real shape has `primaryEmail.{email, createdOn, acceptsMarketing}`, `locale`, and `defaultShippingAddress`. `tags` and internal notes are CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16, to be excluded from this endpoint's response entirely, regardless of whether the contact actually has them — a real tag and note were added to the test contact via the Squarespace admin UI (confirmed saved and visible there), then get_contact was called twice more; both responses were byte-identical to the original, with no trace of either field. `lists` remains unconfirmed either way, since it wasn't exercised by that test. The input field is named `id` here (renamed from an earlier `contactId`) to match src/actions/get-contact.ts's implementation.

input.title: GetContactInput
input.description: Retrieval is by contact id, appended to the contacts collection root as GET /contacts/{id}. CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11: resolveUrl() correctly avoids doubling the /contacts segment — see this schema's top-level VERIFICATION STATUS.

id.description: Contact identifier. Observed ids elsewhere in this API are UUIDs, but no real contact id has been captured, so no format is enforced. Renamed from contactId to id to match src/actions/get-contact.ts.

output.title: GetContactResult
output.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11: the response is wrapped in a top-level `contact` key, not a flat Contact object.

examples.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11 (re-verified 2026-08-16) — the real captured response from GET /contacts/{id}, matching fixtures/contact-by-id.json byte for byte except email, which is replaced with a placeholder.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Cursor pagination envelope. Verified against fixtures/contacts.json. Unused by this single-record action; retained for the list form documented below.

contactAddress.title: ContactAddress
contactAddress.description: Note this has no firstName/lastName/phone, unlike the commerce Address used on orders.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, against exactly one real contact record. Fields present here were observed on that record. Superseded the earlier UNVERIFIED placeholder shape, which had a materially different (flat, non-`primaryEmail`) structure. `tags` and internal notes are CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16, to never appear in this response regardless of whether the contact has them (verified by adding a real tag/note via the Squarespace admin UI, confirming they saved, then re-fetching — no trace of either field before or after; see connector.yaml). `lists` remains unconfirmed either way, since it wasn't exercised by that test — its absence here is still only inferred from the one original record.

lastName.description: Observed as an empty string, not null, on the one confirmed record — kept nullable since that wasn't exercised.

primaryEmail.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11. Replaces the earlier modeled flat `email`/`transactionalEmailStatus` fields, which do not exist on the real response.

defaultShippingAddress.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, only as `null` on the one observed record — shape when non-null is UNVERIFIED. Replaces the earlier modeled `address` field, which does not exist on the real response.

contactListResult.title: ContactListResult
contactListResult.description: NOT the output of this action — documented here because its envelope IS verified against fixtures/contacts.json. Use it if a list_contacts action is added later. Note the array key is `contacts`, unlike orders (`result`).
